limitations: Stationary ordinary Gauss natural extension; immediate neighbors of one digit conditioned on being at least N, integer N tending to infinity. No claim for other continued-fraction algorithms, longer windows or nonstationary measures. Independent historical-priority assessment remains outstanding.
scientific_integrity: Proof uses the previously established Gauss natural-extension invariant measure. Only the conditioned sharp two-sided asymptotics, not the invariant density, are claimed. All logarithms are natural. Reproducible algebraic and numerical checks supplement an analytic proof; they do not establish priority or external validation.
title: Sharp rare-digit screening of two-sided Gauss-map dependence
